$comment: Loki's settings on a RecursicaChat 2.0 server that belong to the agent, the same on every stack. circlechat/rc-sync.sh sets them through the server's API, with the instructions in portable/recursicachat/agents/loki/INSTRUCTIONS.md. The model and the monthly budget belong to the stack: agents.loki.recursicachat in the stack's site.json.
$autonomyComment: ask: Loki asks before each action that is not a read. Loki delivers each transcript with attach_files, a server tool that needs no approval, so a question before an action means a request went outside Loki's work.
$sandboxComment: docker: each turn runs in a container, never on the server itself.
starters: Quick test: one 15-minute interview about meal planning
One 15-minute interview in [English or Spanish] about [your subject]
One 30-minute interview about [your subject], based on the attached persona
Three 15-minute interviews with different people about [your subject]
$startersComment: The suggestions an empty chat with Loki shows, one tap each. A starter with [placeholders] opens a fill-in dialog, one field per placeholder, instead of sending. "Quick test" asks for no personas or sources; the others bring a persona or ask once for one. An interview can be in English or Spanish, so the second starter asks for the language.
